baseName.value: Precast concrete elements for walls, pillars and beams (Based on the concrete recipe type 44b)

generalComment.value: The average EPD (type: Cradle to gate with modules C1–C4 and module D) is about custom made precast concrete based on the concrete recipe type44b5, manufactured in Hattersheim, Germany. The calculation is based on 1 m³ of concrete with a share of 6 m% reinforcing and prestressed steel. Ecobility Experts – Kiwa GmbH shall not be liable with respect to manufacturer information, life cycle assessment data and evidences.

description.value: The average proportion of prestressing steel at the Hattersheim site (type 44b) is 27,7 kg of steel. Modules B1 to B7: For concrete components, maintenance and repair measures are generally not necessary during the reference service life, so that no environmental burdens arise in these modules. In addition, no energy or water is consumed. C1 Demolition: According to the current state of the art, the demolition of concrete and reinforced concrete structures is mainly carried out with longfront excavators equipped with demolition clamps. The concrete buildings are demolished by so-called "press cutting", i.e. the crushing of concrete by applying a compressive force. It is estimated that one site vehicle is in operation for 30 minutes per sqm of concrete element (conservative assumption). C2 - C4 and D: It is assumed that concrete and reinforcement material are separated after deconstruction. For both waste groups, a waste scenario according to the Dutch National Environmental Database (NMD) (SBK 2019) is applied: Concrete (i.a. elements, brickwork): 99% of concrete is recycled and reused as aggregate.; Steel, reinforcement: 95% of reinforcing steel is marketed as scrap metal.

descriptionOfRestrictions.value: The geographical reference area is Germany.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: The products are reinforced and prestressed precast concrete elements in various formats, sizes and applications. The elements are used as columns, walls and beams. The concrete type 44b has compressive strength class of C 55/67. The manufacturing contains the following processes: Delivery of raw materials; Preparation of the moulds (formwork, cutting and laying of the probation steel elements, placeholders); Concrete mixing and filling into the mould, curing; Removal of the formwork, finishing, storage.

technologicalApplicability.value: The products are prefabricated elements for building, civil engineering and bridge construction, balconies, solid ceilings.
